RecordDecisionRequest.description:
Input contract for recording a structured decision.

A decision is a status transition with an explicit outcome and a
review rationale. It is persisted as a ``decision_recorded`` event
(and, when the outcome changes the status, a ``status_changed``
event in the same transaction).

actor_ref.description: Actor reference for the decision author (≤128 chars).
actor_ref.title: Actor Ref

expected_version.description: The case version the caller read; used for optimistic concurrency.
expected_version.title: Expected Version

outcome.description: Decision outcome status (must be a legal transition from the current status).

rationale.description: Structured review rationale for the decision.
rationale.title: Rationale

RecordDecisionRequest.title: RecordDecisionRequest

info.description: Public Expenditure & Infrastructure Anomaly Review System (PEIARS) — versioned JSON API. Research evidence is served read-only and manifest-verified; an anomaly flag never implies fraud. This API never fits models, recomputes thresholds or mutates frozen research artifacts.
info.title: PEIARS API

get.description: Issues a signed double-submit CSRF token: the value is set in the readable CSRF cookie and returned in the body. The client must echo it in the X-CSRF-Token header on every state-changing request (login, logout, and future writes).

post.description: Verifies credentials, creates a fresh server-side session and sets the secure session cookie. Failures are generic; throttled attempts return 429. Requires the X-CSRF-Token header from GET /api/v1/auth/csrf.

503.description: Authentication is not configured or the database is unavailable.

post.description: Requires a valid session and the X-CSRF-Token header. Revokes the server-side session (irreversible) and expires the cookies. Replay of the old session fails.

503.description: Authentication is not configured or the database is unavailable.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's approved public fields and effective permissions. Requires the session cookie.

503.description: Authentication is not configured or the database is unavailable.

get.description: Paginated list of accessible review cases, deterministically ordered by created_at then id. Available to viewer, reviewer and admin.

post.description: Creates a review case bound to a synthetic demonstration record. The actor is derived from the authenticated principal; client-supplied created_by is ignored. Requires reviewer or admin role.

get.description: Retrieves a single review case by its server-generated UUID. Available to viewer, reviewer and admin.

post.description: Records a structured decision (outcome + rationale). When the outcome changes the status, a status_changed event is also written in the same transaction. The actor is derived from the authenticated principal. Requires reviewer or admin role.

get.description: Returns the append-only event history for a case, deterministically ordered by case_version then event_seq. Available to viewer, reviewer and admin.

post.description: Appends a reviewer note as a note_added event and bumps the case version. The actor is derived from the authenticated principal. Requires reviewer or admin role.
Applies a legal status transition (PR-03 domain validator). The actor is derived from the authenticated principal. Requires reviewer or admin role.

get.description: Proves the API process is answering requests. Performs no database, model, DVC or network access.

Reports whether all configured, required application dependencies are ready. PR-02 configures no required external dependencies, so the default response is ready with an empty checks list. Optional research artifacts are not readiness dependencies.
Non-sensitive build and capability metadata. The Git commit SHA is included only when supplied by the deployment environment.
Lists the approved, registered data sources. No sources are admitted in PR-02, so this returns an empty list. Sources are never discovered by scanning the filesystem.
Fetches a single approved source by its opaque registered identifier. Path-like identifiers are rejected.
Lists the deterministic synthetic demonstration records. Explicitly fictional — NOT research findings. Only available when the demonstration_sources flag is enabled.
